Job Stories: As a user, I want to view my billing details and subscription plans so that I can manage payments easily.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Displays current plan, billing history, and invoices.
- Allows plan changes or updates.
- Error messages for payment issues are clear.
UX Considerations / Interactions: Dashboard-style layout with clear CTAs; responsive table that adapts to mobile screens.

Job Stories: As a goal-oriented user, I want to review and edit my business goals so my dashboard reflects what matters most to me.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Goals are editable and saved.
- Progress toward each goal is clearly displayed.
- Input errors are handled appropriately.
UX Considerations / Interactions: Visual goal trackers with inline editing capabilities; responsive design for mobile adjustments.

Job Stories: As a user, I want to update my fixed costs and COGS so that profit calculations remain accurate.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Data is validated and saved instantly.
- Calculations update immediately.
- Robust error handling is implemented.
UX Considerations / Interactions: Simple form elements with clear labels; contextual help provided; responsive design.

Job Stories: As a user, I want to set my notification preferences so that I can control how and when I receive alerts or updates.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Toggle switches work correctly and save user preferences.
- Changes are reflected immediately.
- Errors are clearly displayed, if any occur.
UX Considerations / Interactions: Familiar toggle switches with clear tooltips; layout is responsive across devices.

Job Stories: As a user, I want a central hub to manage all my integrations so I can easily connect or disconnect services.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Lists all connected accounts with their statuses.
- Add/Remove functionality works.
- Errors are clearly communicated with remedial steps.
UX Considerations / Interactions: Card- or list-based dashboard; status indicated clearly with icons and colors.

Job Stories: As a user, I want clear indicators of integration status (active, needs re-auth, error) so that I stay informed at a glance.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Each integration displays its current status.
- Hover/tap shows additional details.
- Auto-refresh is implemented without user intervention.
UX Considerations / Interactions: Intuitive icons and hover tooltips; consistent UI language; ensures mobile adaptation.

Job Stories: As a user, I want AI to suggest new integrations based on my current setup so I can optimize my connected data sources.
Acceptance Criteria:
- AI returns recommended integrations based on usage data.
- Suggestions are displayed with clear "Add" options.
- Error states are managed.
UX Considerations / Interactions: Prominent suggestion banner or widget; design consistent with the connected accounts hub.

Job Stories: As a user, I want to search the help center so I can quickly find answers without contacting support.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Search returns relevant help articles.
- Database is categorized and paginated.
- Error handling provides useful suggestions.
UX Considerations / Interactions: Clean, minimal interface for articles; responsive design with a clear search bar for mobile devices.

Feature: Help Center – Natural Language Search Capability
Job Stories: As a user, I want to ask questions in my own words to find help so that I feel understood and receive precise answers.
Acceptance Criteria:
- NL search understands common phrases.
- Returns highly relevant results.
- Fallback suggestions provided if no results are found.
UX Considerations / Interactions: Chat-like interface for NL queries; accessible fonts and clear instructions provided.

Feature: How-To Guides & Short Video Tutorials Section
Job Stories: As a new user, I want easy-to-follow guides and tutorials so I can learn the platform features quickly.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Guides load quickly and are organized by topic.
- Video tutorials play seamlessly (with in-app lightbox).
- Error handling and retries are supported.
UX Considerations / Interactions: Card or list interface with clear playback controls; adaptive design for videos on both mobile and desktop.

Job Stories: As a new user, I want a glossary of common terms so that I can quickly understand product-specific language.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Glossary displays with keyword search support.
- Terms are clearly defined.
- Responsive layout with robust error handling.
UX Considerations / Interactions: Clear list format with expandable definitions; easily navigable on desktop and mobile.

Job Stories: As a user needing assistance, I want a simple contact form so that I can reach support without leaving the app environment.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Form submissions are processed and yield confirmation messages.
- Invalid inputs are handled with clear error messages.
- Data privacy is maintained.
UX Considerations / Interactions: Clean, minimal form design with clear labels and instructions; mobile-friendly form fields.

Job Stories: As a frustrated user, I want to access live chat quickly so that I can get real-time support for urgent issues.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Chat support initiates within 2 minutes.
- Chat window works reliably on all devices.
- Errors provide fallback options.
UX Considerations / Interactions: Popup or fixed-position chat button clearly visible; responsive design with smooth animations.

Feature: AI Chatbot for Initial Support Queries
Job Stories: As a user, I want an AI-driven chatbot to handle basic support queries so that I minimize my wait time for assistance.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Chatbot responds within 2 seconds for common queries.
- Escalation to human support is available if needed.
- Interactions are logged for improvement.
UX Considerations / Interactions: Conversational UI with engaging avatars/icons; clear placement on the interface.

Job Stories: As a user, I want to provide feedback directly within the app so that I can help improve the product seamlessly.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Feedback is accepted and stored with a confirmation message.
- Error states (e.g., empty submission) are clearly managed.
- Option to rate the experience available.
UX Considerations / Interactions: Non-intrusive modal or fixed feedback button; simple text area with character counters; responsive design.

Job Stories: As a user, I want to securely log out so that my session ends appropriately and my account remains protected.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Log out immediately ends the session.
- User is redirected to the login page.
- Errors and session timeouts are handled gracefully.
UX Considerations / Interactions: Clearly labeled, accessible log out button; optional confirmation prompt if needed.

Job Stories: As a user, I want the system to securely manage my session so that my sensitive data is protected during inactivity.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Automatic session timeout is implemented.
- Token management and re-authentication are seamless.
- Security notifications are displayed if needed.
UX Considerations / Interactions: Transparent background processing with non-intrusive notifications or modal dialogs for session expiration.
